_about: Word bank for the Generators page. A draw takes a Who, a What and a Where; "slots" says which noun and adjective groups feed each. The What is either a thing or a happening, each with its own groups. hooks.templates and hooks.tables build story hooks about the Who; hooks.scenes are hooks that use all three slots, split by the kind of What. Placeholders are written "the {who}", "the {what}", "the {where}". "retired" lists nouns and adjectives removed from the starter list; they are dropped when an older campaign is upgraded. "version" tells the app when to upgrade.
